name: Embetsu (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Embetsu town emblem in yellow: two concentric broken rings.
history: Municipal flag of Embetsu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 29 March 1949.

features.role: Embetsu town emblem — two concentric broken rings
